# Prima — Design Notes & Task Outline

Source: ColorLib "Unica" → https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/unica/
New name: prima (apps/prima)

## Section Build Order

1. **Navbar** — Logo left, info items (clock + pin icons) right. Dark navy bar with white links, orange active pill, search/cart icons. Mobile hamburger.
2. **Hero** — Full-width slider with dark image overlay. Orange subtitle, white heading, body text, orange pill CTA. Slider dots.
3. **Counter** — Dark navy bar. Graduation-cap icon in white circle, "Next Course" info, countdown timer (days/hours/mins/secs).
4. **Services** — Section title "OUR SERVICES". 6 cards in 3-col grid: icon (from picsum), title, description.
5. **Enroll** — Dark overlay background. Section title, checkmark list items, CTA button.
6. **Courses** — 3 cards in row. Each: thumbnail with orange category badge, title, read-more link.
7. **Facts** — Background image (picsum). 4 stat counters: icon, large number, label.
8. **Events** — 3 cards. Each: thumbnail with date badge, title, description, read-more link.
9. **Gallery** — Image grid (picsum thumbnails). Click opens popup/larger view.
10. **Blog** — 3 cards. Each: thumbnail, title, meta (date, author).
11. **Newsletter** — Light gray bg (#f7f7f7). Centered title + description, email input + orange button.
12. **Footer** — Dark navy bg (#020031). Multi-column links. Copyright with border. Component Dock link.

## Fidelity Notes

- **Colors:** Primary #f6783a (orange), dark bg #020031 (navy), headings #111, body #636363.
- **Font:** Rubik (400, 500, 700) — load via Google Fonts link in index.html.
- **Buttons:** Pill (border-radius 50px), orange bg, white text, uppercase, min-width 170px.
- **Cards:** border-radius 10px on course/event thumbnails.
- **Nav:** Dark navy background, white text, active item orange bg pill.
- **Hero:** Full-width, background image, text left-aligned, orange subtitle uppercase.
- **Counter:** Dark navy bg, white circle with graduation cap, countdown numbers in white.
- **Fact section:** Background image with overlay, 4 stat items.
- **Newsletter:** Light gray bg, centered layout, email input + orange submit.
- **Footer:** Dark navy, 4-column links, copyright border-top #312f56.
